mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, creating a positive interaction effect that drives S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production above 100.0 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing strength that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO above 100.0 but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% monthly signals accelerating price pressures that trigger Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL monthly change above 2.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive over 20 days in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth above 2.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high employment growth regimes, monthly payroll gains above 0.5% (PAYEMS) strengthen consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high employment growth regime, PAYEMS growth above 0.5% but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index above 105.0 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through supply chain strength.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105.0 but S&P 500 returns are negative over 5 days in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
